findings.evidence: The declaration at line 159 exposes `hU`, `hf`, and `hUR`, while Mathlib/Analysis/Complex/CauchyIntegral.lean defines `DifferentiableOn.circleIntegral_sub_inv_smul` and `DifferentiableOn.hasFPowerSeriesOnBall` directly from differentiability on `closedBall c R`, providing the standard weaker regularity level and the higher Taylor coefficients.
findings.fix: State the corollary from `hf : DifferentiableOn ℂ f (closedBall c R)` (or prove that general form first and derive the current neighborhood form).
findings.issue: `circleIntegral_div_sub_pow_of_differentiableOn` requires an open `U`, differentiability on all of `U`, and `closedBall c R ⊆ U`; this is stronger and less usable than the natural `DifferentiableOn ℂ f (closedBall c R)` hypothesis used by Mathlib’s closed-disc Cauchy API.

summary: The circle corollary is stated with unnecessarily strong neighborhood holomorphy instead of the standard closed-disc assumption.
